name: Musée national des Arts et Traditions Populaires
description: French museum of the performing arts including puppetry

summary.text: The Musée national des Arts et Traditions Populaires was a museum of the popular arts and traditions of France. It was located in a building at 6, avenue du Mahatma Gandhi, Paris, France, which was closed to the public in 2005.
summary.title: Musée national des Arts et Traditions Populaires (France)
